def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    starting_index = 121
    starting_prices = [15, 20, 30]
    ending_prices = [20, 30, 25]

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    returns = [
        (ending - starting) / starting
        for starting, ending in zip(starting_prices, ending_prices)
    ]
    average_return = sum(returns) / len(returns)
    answer = round(starting_index * (1 + average_return), 3)

    # return answer
    return answer
